keypoints.name: Betaflight Angle Mode Problems
keypoints.description: The video identifies and explains two main problems with Betaflight's angle mode: slow speed/responsiveness compared to acro mode, and wobbliness during sharp yaw movements.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: The video is structured around the problems and solutions for angle mode.  The presenter introduces, develops, and returns to the main issues throughout the video.
representative_quotes: the problems with angle mode that Betaflight has currently
What's causing that really bad wobble

keypoints.name: Feedforward in Angle Mode
keypoints.description: The video explains how implementing feedforward from acro mode into angle mode addresses the slow responsiveness issue by providing an initial push to the quad based on stick movement.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Feedforward is covered in a dedicated section and its function is explained in detail with visual aids.  The benefits are discussed and later revisited in the context of testing the code.
representative_quotes: adding feedforward into angle mode made the biggest difference

keypoints.name: Yaw Coordination
keypoints.description: The video describes how the wobbliness in angle mode during yaw movements is caused by coordinate system misalignment, and it demonstrates a code-based solution to coordinate yaw and roll to mitigate the issue.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: The yaw issue is covered in a dedicated section with a demonstration. The cause of the wobble and the code-based solution are explained in detail.

keypoints.name: Testing Betaflight Test Code
keypoints.description: The video provides instructions on how to back up configuration, download the test code from a PR, flash the firmware, apply custom defaults, and adjust settings in Betaflight Configurator.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: The last third of the video walks through the steps for backing up configs and testing new firmware. The presenter goes step by step through finding, flashing, and implementing the code.
representative_quotes: test this code out for yourself
